question.problem:
$$
X=[\begin{aligned}7 & 8 & 0 & -3 \\ -2 & 10 & -3 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the observation matrix $X$ above, where the individual observations are given in columns. Find the sample mean vector of $X.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the sample mean vector is given by

$$
m=\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i},
$$

where ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n}$ are the individual observations (columns of $X$).

From the matrix, we have that  

$$
{x}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}7 \\ -2\end{aligned}],\,{x}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}8 \\ 10\end{aligned}],\,{x}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\,{x}_{4}=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 3\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, the sample mean is

$$
\begin{aligned}m & =\frac{1}{4}({x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}+{x}_{4}) \\  & =\frac{1}{4}([\begin{aligned}7 \\ -2\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}8 \\ 10\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -3\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 3\end{aligned}]) \\  & =\frac{1}{4}[\begin{aligned}12 \\ 8\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
